description: Drive a real Chromium browser on one public page: click, type, press keys, scroll, wait for selectors, then return the resulting text (and optionally a screenshot and JSON XHR responses). When to use: the page needs interaction before its content appears (cookie banners, tabs, 'load more', form submit) and web_fetch/web_crawl cannot see it. Do not use: for plain reading (web_fetch) or bulk crawling (web_crawl); no login/paywall bypass. Returns: {ok, url, final_url, title, markdown, chars, elapsed_ms, screenshot?, xhr?, took_ms, _metering}. Max 10 actions; screenshot returns MCP image content. Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP shared by all web tools), then 3 credits per call over x402.

include_xhr.description: Return JSON XHR responses captured while acting. Default false.

screenshot.description: Return a JPEG screenshot. Default false.

name: web_act
title: Web Act
